correctness.rationale: The explicit 15! Stirling exponential sum is exact; the eight-residue coefficient certificate was computed modulo 8192 and propagated to all n>=10 via a proved squaring recurrence. Vandermonde bounds all higher odd terms, giving exact valuation n+r+12 before 15!; even bases give exact valuation b2^n+6 by the 8128=64*127 congruence. The cancellation boundary receives only the justified lower bound. Independent executable modular and recurrence calculations were replayed.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A valuation of two terms separately does not determine their difference. Nor does a special c->2c step imply arbitrary-a,b differences, because a telescoping sum can cancel. Our proof controls all a,b and quantifies the high-divisibility boundary, so the new conclusion is not implied by those statements.

value.rationale: Index 15 is the first natural exceptional k=2^m-1 case remaining unresolved in the 2014 arbitrary-pair difference theorem, not an unmotivated slice. The proof establishes the conjectured asymptotic valuation for every fixed pair and an exact finite-level two-adic saturation regime with a sharp critical boundary, explaining the failure of uniformity.
